provenance.methodology: Fresh-context reviewer independently assigned all labels using frozen policy and original inputs only; initial labels saved before author labels were opened. Then compared route plus requiresHumanReview. No disagreements, ambiguities or changes.
limitations: AI-reviewed synthetic evidence; not human adjudication.
Author and reviewer are separate AI contexts, not a blind benchmark of provider training exposure.
Finite 40-case policy-specific sample; no statistical population-performance claim.
